normalization_policy: Never normalize by the min/max of the compared method set.

executed_raw.purpose: closed-loop execution, collision, physics, and planner-failure claims

executed_logged_matched.purpose: comparison with 2 Hz logged empirical behavior support only
executed_logged_matched.prohibition: must not hide or replace 10 Hz executed physics failures

proposal_future.prohibition: must never be pooled with executed rollout states

continuity.yaw_rate: finite active same-track pairs with wrapped yaw difference

aggregation.all_agent_plausibility_rate: all scored agents pass both required views
aggregation.scene_pass_rate: passing scored tracks divided by all scored tracks

collision.zero_collateral_primary: no new post-intervention non-target collision pair

paired_primary_endpoint.population: native arm is safe and valid under the single tested ego planner
paired_primary_endpoint.pairing: same scene, executed prefix, seed, active support, FM initial latent, and tested planner
paired_primary_endpoint.success: guided arm creates a new target OBB event or a new planner failure while native remains safe
paired_primary_endpoint.prohibition: native and guided are not two different planners

joint_criticality.joint_rarity: calibrated against held-out logged joint distributions, not inferred from marginal gates

emergent_cascade_paper_metrics.all_agent_plausibility_rate: every participating agent is locally plausible
emergent_cascade_paper_metrics.emergence_gap: joint planner risk minus maximum single-agent counterfactual risk
emergent_cascade_paper_metrics.strict_emergence_success: joint risk is high and every single-agent counterfactual risk is low
emergent_cascade_paper_metrics.chain_necessity_rate: fraction of target-chain events whose removal reduces risk by the frozen threshold

domain_boundary.nuscenes: CrashDojo traffic generation and the tested ego planner
domain_boundary.nuplan: official native-domain planner evaluation through a separate adapter
domain_boundary.prohibition: M2 traffic flow matching must not be called the nuPlan Flow Planner
